descriptions.description: Cichorium pumilum is a Mediterranean species of plant in the tribe Cichorieae within the family Asteraceae . Like the two other species of Cichorium, its leaves are edible by humans. The plant produces bluish-violet flower heads and fleshy taproots.Altervista Flora Italiana, Endivia selvatica, Cichorium pumilum Jacq.
